provenance.operation: Same 144-time initial motion, model, bounds, displacement and slip objective as the prior continued weighted control. Replace zero-balance weighted restoration with physical tolerance inequalities and three AL outer iterations of ten LM iterations. Inner restarts and shifted inequality penalties are intentional algorithm differences; finite iteration caps are not equal computational cost or convergence.
provenance.formulation: Section 14.6, equation 46: squared positive shifted inequality residual, omitting an x-independent constant.
